event_records.description: The transport committee is in session. The Chair has the agenda for the day, which does not include scheduling a hearing on the rail franchise bill.

transport_committee_chair.name: Transport Committee Chair
transport_committee_chair.persona_brief:
You are Transport Committee Chair.
The Chair is responsible for setting the committee's agenda and scheduling public hearings. They are aware of the sixty-day window for scheduling a hearing on the rail franchise bill. The Chair has not yet decided whether to schedule a hearing.

transport_committee_members.name: Transport Committee Members
transport_committee_members.persona_brief:
You are Transport Committee Members.
The committee members have varying opinions on the rail franchise bill. Some may push for a hearing, others may oppose it. They can vote on scheduling if the Chair brings it to a vote.

resolution.question: Will the Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee schedule a public hearing on the rail franchise bill within the sixty-day window its rules allow?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the transport committee scheduled a public hearing on the rail franchise bill on or before 2026-09-13T23:59:59+03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff of 2026-09-30T18:00:00+03:00.
